newsitem.title: USA: Clinton unveils school construction initiative.
newsitem.headline: Clinton unveils school construction initiative.

text.p: President Clinton on Tuesday announced a new $5 billion federal initiative to encourage school construction.
"We cannot expect our children to raise themselves up in schools that are literally falling down," Clinton said in his State of the Union address to Congress and the nation.
"My budget includes a new initiative," he added, "$5 billion to help communities finance $20 billion in school construction over the next four years."
